title: Feature: Keyboard shortcuts + discoverable help overlay for DiffViewer

src/components/ui/* — shadcn primitives (Dialog available for help overlay)

steps.description: Add src/hooks/use-keyboard-shortcuts.js. Accepts a map { 'mod+enter': handler, 'mod+k': handler, 'escape': handler, '?': handler }. Normalizes mod -> metaKey on darwin, ctrlKey elsewhere. Attaches single window listener, respects target.isContentEditable and INPUT/TEXTAREA focus (only 'escape' and 'mod+enter' fire inside editors). Returns nothing; cleanup on unmount.
steps.done_condition: hook file exists; manual test: mod+enter fires from anywhere incl. textarea; plain letters do NOT fire inside inputs

steps.description: Wire shortcuts in DiffViewer.jsx: mod+enter -> handleCompare, mod+k -> focus left editor, mod+shift+k -> focus right editor, escape -> setError(null), '?' -> setHelpOpen(true). Shortcuts are no-ops when the respective preconditions fail (e.g. mod+enter does nothing when before/after empty — mirrors existing button disabled state).
steps.done_condition: all five shortcuts work from keyboard without clicking; no regression to existing button handlers

steps.description: Add src/components/diff/ShortcutsHelp.jsx — Dialog listing all shortcuts with <kbd> styling. Two columns: Compare/Navigate (mod+enter, mod+k, mod+shift+k) and General (escape, ?). Closes on escape or overlay click. Use existing Dialog primitive from @/components/ui/dialog. Labels use 'Cmd' on mac, 'Ctrl' elsewhere (detect once via navigator.platform).
steps.done_condition: pressing '?' opens dialog; dialog renders correct modifier labels per platform; escape closes it

steps.description: Add small '?' hint button in DiffViewer header (next to scroll-lock / theme toggle). aria-label='Keyboard shortcuts'. Opens ShortcutsHelp. Same h-8 rounded-md stone-400 hover styling as sibling buttons. This makes shortcuts discoverable without requiring users to know to press '?'.
steps.done_condition: button visible in header, clicking opens same dialog as '?' key
